Create ONE new photorealistic production photograph guided by the attached reference grip. The reference demonstrates the required hand pose and smartphone-shaped opening. Do not reproduce its checkerboard, rounded screenshot container, white margins or UI.
SUBJECT: a realistic adult right hand with medium warm brown skin, natural short clean nails, gently and securely holding an upright portrait smartphone. Four separate curled fingertips sit along the LEFT edge, with their nails facing viewer. The thumb lies naturally along the RIGHT edge, thumb pad facing left toward phone, relaxed rather than sticking out. The palm cups the lower-right and underside; the forearm enters diagonally from the RIGHT edge toward the lower centre. Exactly five digits with coherent anatomy. No open waving palm.
DEVICE: a plain flat front-facing portrait smartphone-shaped rigid dummy slab. It is a perfectly straight vertical rounded rectangle, minimal perspective, approximately 1:2 width:height. The entire visible slab, including its side rim, is one uniform pure vivid BLUE RGB(0,0,255), no black border, no camera, no speaker, no text, no reflections. The blue slab gives a clean exact removable silhouette. Its four corners have a small realistic radius. Fingertips and thumb touch the lateral OUTSIDE edges, with at most tiny contact with the rim. No finger crosses onto the flat blue front face. All four left fingertips visible as in the reference. Show the entire device from top to bottom, enough space above it.
BACKGROUND: perfectly uniform solid bright chroma GREEN RGB(0,255,0), no pattern, no shadows or colour spill on skin. Soft neutral studio light on the hand only. Real photographic skin, no painted or plastic look. No jewellery, sleeves, tattoos, extra objects or watermark.
COMPOSITION: landscape 3:2 canvas, 1536x1024 preferred, phone positioned left of centre with top at about 7 percent and bottom about 77 percent of canvas height, left edge about 29 percent and right edge about 53 percent canvas width. Four fingertips sit just outside left edge; thumb and palm outside right edge. The forearm exits the right edge in lower-right quadrant; do not show an abrupt cut stump within image. A usable hand holding a replaceable smartphone viewport. ONE image, not a sheet.
